hotwire.add.heads_up: Heads up: a few of its changes only work for new things from now on, or after a restart: %s.
hotwire.add.next_start.where: In your mods folder for the next time you launch.
hotwire.add.next_start.undo: You can undo this any time under Pending tasks.
hotwire.cache.fill_explains: This works out every mod's switch ahead of time and saves it in the Centralized Switch Cache, so switching mods is much faster. Nothing is turned off.
hotwire.cache.fill_playing: You can keep playing while it fills. It steps aside whenever you switch a mod, and you can pause it any time.
hotwire.cache.fill_once: Only needed once per game version, and it stays saved.
hotwire.cache.fill_size_pending: Estimated compressed file size: measuring your mods...
hotwire.cache.outdated: Out of date: Hotwire or one of your mods changed since this was filled. Switches still work, just slower, until you refill it.
hotwire.cache.limit: The switch cache's disk limit, shared by this version's instances.
hotwire.cache.store_limit: What the store keeps of Modrinth's answers, shared by every instance.
hotwire.cache.limit_over: Your mods need about %s, more than the %s limit: the oldest saves make room for new ones.
hotwire.first_open.title: Before you use Hotwire
hotwire.first_open.what: Hotwire changes mods while the game is running.
hotwire.first_open.work: Mods weren't made for that. Hotwire does the hard part.
hotwire.first_open.report: If a mod acts weird after Hotwire touched it, tell Hotwire, not the mod's maker.
hotwire.first_open.crash: Every crash report says if Hotwire was part of it.
hotwire.add.not_here: Adding mods from this screen isn't in this version yet.
hotwire.updates.title: Updates on Modrinth
hotwire.updates.none: Every mod Modrinth knows is at its newest version for your game.
hotwire.updates.found_one: 1 of your mods has a newer version on Modrinth. See Updates.
hotwire.updates.found: %d of your mods have newer versions on Modrinth. See Updates.
hotwire.updates.needs_first: %s needs %d mods at newer versions first; getting them from Modrinth.
hotwire.updates.getting_for_update: Getting %s from Modrinth for the update
hotwire.screen.drop_wait: Wait for this to finish, then drop the jar again.
hotwire.screen.drop_jar_only: Only a mod's .jar file can go in.
hotwire.pending.ignored: The old versions are off the list. Their jars are still in hotwire/replaced.
hotwire.screen.pick_limit: You can pick up to %s mods at once. Switch these first, then pick more.
hotwire.screen.pick_limit_stopped: You can pick up to %s mods at once, so picking stopped there. Switch these first, then pick more.
hotwire.setup.name_hint: Type a name, then press Enter
hotwire.setup.deleted: Deleted '%s'. Nothing in the game changed.
hotwire.setup.name_prompt: Type a name, then press Enter. Escape to cancel.
hotwire.setup.rename_prompt: New name for '%s'. Enter to save, Escape to cancel.
hotwire.setup.name_taken: There's already a setup called '%s'. Pick another name.
hotwire.pending.none: Nothing is waiting for the next launch.
hotwire.pending.update: When you close the game, %s goes into your mods folder.
hotwire.pending.update_replacing: When you close the game, %s goes into your mods folder and %s moves to hotwire/replaced.
hotwire.pending.close_failed: Last time the game closed, this didn't work: %s
hotwire.pending.copied: Added live. %s was copied into your mods folder so it loads next time too. Undo removes that copy.
hotwire.pending.revertable: %s is kept in hotwire/replaced. Revert puts it back when you close the game.
hotwire.reopen.title.leave: Leave the server to finish this
hotwire.reopen.title.reopen: Reopen your world to finish this
hotwire.reopen.plan.leave: Hotwire leaves the server and makes the change. Join again whenever you like.
hotwire.reopen.plan.add: Hotwire saves your world, adds the mod, and opens your world again.
hotwire.reopen.plan.reopen: Hotwire saves your world and opens it again.
hotwire.reopen.plan.switch: Hotwire saves your world, makes the change, and opens your world again.
hotwire.reopen.safe.server: Nothing on the server is lost.
hotwire.reopen.safe.world: Your world is saved first. Nothing is lost.
hotwire.update.same_version: %s %s is already the version you have.
hotwire.update.not_installed: That jar is not a version of a mod you have; its mod id is %s.
hotwire.update.not_compared: It can't be compared with the running version: %s
hotwire.update.new_id: Its mod id changes from %s to %s, so it loads next time you start the game.
hotwire.update.new_id_needed: %s changes its mod id to %s, and %s need it by its old one.
hotwire.panel.more_in_log: There's more in the game's log.
hotwire.progress.world_closed: Your world is saved and closed for this.
hotwire.progress.world_opens: It opens again by itself. Don't leave or close the game.
hotwire.progress.taking_out: Taking it out of other mods
hotwire.progress.looking: Checking what other mods keep of it
hotwire.progress.reloading_models: Reloading textures and models (the game pauses for a moment)
hotwire.progress.rebuilding_renderers: Rebuilding how it draws (the game pauses for a moment)
hotwire.switch.turned_off_kept: Turned off %s in %s. It stays off, even after a restart, until you turn it on.
hotwire.switch.kept_off_failed: It's off until you close the game, but Hotwire couldn't keep it off for next time: %s.
hotwire.switch.brought_back_failed: %s is back on, but its jar couldn't get its name back (%s). Next time you start, it stays off until you turn it on again.
hotwire.switch.failed_off: Couldn't turn off %s, so nothing changed: %s. The log has more.
hotwire.switch.failed_on: Couldn't turn on %s, so nothing changed: %s. The log has more.
hotwire.switch.partly_off: Partly off: %s still running. A restart clears it.
hotwire.switch.one_fault: 1 thing went wrong on the way. Hotwire wrote a bug report.
hotwire.switch.faults: %s things went wrong on the way. Hotwire wrote a bug report.
hotwire.refusal.protected_off: %s can't be turned off. The game needs it.
hotwire.refusal.protected_on: %s can't be turned on. The game needs it.
hotwire.refusal.breaks: %s can't come on while %s is on. It says it breaks it.
hotwire.api.takes_along: Turning off %s would turn off %s too, so %s can't do it.
hotwire.api.unknown: Hotwire can't tell which mod is asking, so it won't turn mods off for it.
hotwire.api.unknown_row: Hotwire can't tell which mod is asking.
hotwire.api.in_request: %s is part of this request, so it has to stay on.
hotwire.switch.world_locked: In-world switching is off in Advanced. Leave the world, then switch.
hotwire.update.changes_one: It changes 1 class while the game runs.
hotwire.update.changes: It changes %s classes while the game runs.
hotwire.update.shape_one: 1 of its classes changes in a way a running game can't take.
hotwire.update.shape: %s of its classes change in a way a running game can't take.
hotwire.update.patched_one: Mods that stay on change 1 of its classes.
hotwire.update.patched: Mods that stay on change %s of its classes.
hotwire.update.entrypoint_new: It starts up in new ways.
hotwire.update.tier.in_place: Updates the running mod right now. No restart.
hotwire.update.when.now: Updates right now, while you play. No restart.
hotwire.update.when.restart: Hotwire can't update this mod live. Update it next time you start the game?
hotwire.update.tier.next_start: The new version loads next time you start the game.
hotwire.update.done_one: %s is %s now. 1 class changed in place.
hotwire.update.done: %s is %s now. %s classes changed in place.
hotwire.update.done_one_later: %s is %s now. 1 class changed in place, %s more as they load.
hotwire.update.done_later: %s is %s now. %s classes changed in place, %s more as they load.
hotwire.update.queued: %s %s is waiting. When you close the game, the new jar goes into your mods folder and the old one into hotwire/replaced. Cancel any time under Pending tasks.
hotwire.update.note.patched: %s is changed by %s, which stay on; their changes go onto the new version.
hotwire.update.note.off: The mod is off. It takes the new version now and runs it when you turn it on.
hotwire.update.note.added: The mod was added while the game ran; the new version takes its place.
hotwire.update.note.updated: The mod was updated once already while the game ran; this goes on top.
hotwire.update.note.widener: Its access widener changed; what it opens goes in with the classes.
hotwire.update.note.entrypoint: The new version starts up in a new way (%s); that runs once it is in.
hotwire.update.blocker.entrypoint: The new version adds the %s entrypoint %s.
hotwire.update.blocker.unmet: The new version needs %s %s, and the game doesn't have it.
hotwire.update.blocker.added: The mod was added while the game ran.
hotwire.update.blocker.updated: The mod was already updated once while the game ran.
hotwire.update.blocker.never: The game needs it running, so it updates when you close the game.
hotwire.update.blocker.shape: %s changes in a way a running class can't take: %s
hotwire.update.blocker.patched: %s is changed by %s, which stay on.
hotwire.update.resources_one_now: 1 texture, sound or data file is different. It shows after the next resource reload (F3+T).
hotwire.update.resources_now: %s textures, sounds or data files are different. They show after the next resource reload (F3+T).
hotwire.update.resources_one_later: 1 texture, sound or data file is different. It shows next time you start the game.
hotwire.update.resources_later: %s textures, sounds or data files are different. They show next time you start the game.
hotwire.settings.off_lasts: After a restart, mods you turned off
hotwire.settings.off_lasts.session.note: They turn back on when you start the game again.
hotwire.settings.off_lasts.until_on.note: They stay off until you turn them on.
hotwire.settings.in_world.off.note: Leave the world first to switch mods.
hotwire.settings.nested.auto.note: A mod's own parts go with it.
hotwire.settings.nested.all.note: Every jar inside a mod goes with it.
hotwire.settings.nested.none.note: Jars inside a mod stay as they are.
hotwire.settings.pause: Pause the game while Hotwire is open
hotwire.settings.pause.no.note: The world keeps going behind Hotwire.
hotwire.settings.pause.yes.note: Pauses a singleplayer world, like the Esc menu.
hotwire.add.read_failed: %s can't be added. Reading it failed: %s
hotwire.add.other_loader: %s is a %s mod. Hotwire only adds Fabric mods, so get the Fabric version of it.
hotwire.add.other_minecraft: %s is made for Minecraft %s, and you're playing %s. Get the version made for your Minecraft.
hotwire.add.newer_loader: %s needs a newer Fabric Loader. Update Fabric Loader in your launcher, then add it again.
hotwire.add.server_only: %s only works on servers. It does nothing in your game.
hotwire.add.resource_pack: %s is a resource pack, not a mod. Add it under Options > Resource Packs.
hotwire.add.shader_pack: %s is a shader pack, not a mod. It goes in your shaderpacks folder.
hotwire.add.data_pack: %s is a data pack, not a mod. It goes in a world's datapacks folder.
hotwire.add.not_a_jar: %s isn't a mod file. Mods are .jar files.
hotwire.add.nested_unreadable: %s can't be added. A jar inside it can't be read: %s
hotwire.add.nested_unwritable: %s can't be added. A jar inside it couldn't be unpacked: %s
hotwire.add.later.start_only: %s goes in at the next start: Hotwire never adds or removes it while the game runs.
hotwire.add.later.running: It changes parts of the game that are already running, so it can only go in when the game starts.
hotwire.add.later.library: It brings a newer version of a library the game started with, so it can only go in when the game starts.
hotwire.add.opens: Opens %s parts of the game's classes as they load
hotwire.add.opens_loaded: Opens %s parts of the game's classes, %s on classes already loaded, which Hotwire handles
hotwire.add.makes_refused: %s makes %s, which a world only takes when it opens. %s
hotwire.add.makes: Makes %s, which a world only takes when it opens. Hotwire saves your world, closes it, adds the mod, and opens it again
hotwire.add.makes_use_reopen: %s makes %s, which a world only takes when it opens. Use Save and add: it saves your world, adds the mod, and opens the world again.
hotwire.reopen.single_player_only: Save and add works in a single-player world. On a server, add it from the title screen.
hotwire.reopen.lan: This world is open to LAN, so it can't be closed for the add. Close it to LAN, or add the mod from the title screen.
hotwire.reopen.not_reopened: The world didn't open again (%s). Open it from the world list.
hotwire.switch.no_instrument: Hotwire can't change classes in this game: %s
hotwire.reopen.why.off_server: These can't turn off while you're on this server.
hotwire.reopen.why.on_server: These can't turn on while you're on this server.
hotwire.reopen.why.off_world: These can't turn off while your world is open.
hotwire.reopen.why.on_world: These can't turn on while your world is open.
hotwire.report.crash_title: This crash was caused by Hotwire
hotwire.report.crash_blame: Report it to Hotwire only, not to the maker of any mod.
hotwire.report.show_ask: Open the folder with that file now?
hotwire.add.pick: Pick the mod's .jar file, or drop it onto this screen.
hotwire.update.pick: Pick the newer .jar file, or drop it onto this screen.
hotwire.add.world_open: It can't be added while your world is open.
hotwire.add.start_only: Part of it can only start together with the game.
hotwire.add.finishes_at_join: It's in. Part of it only starts when you join a world, so it finishes at your next join.
hotwire.screen.no_picker: No file window opened on this system. Drop the .jar file onto this screen instead.
hotwire.self_change: Hotwire can't add, update or turn off itself while it runs. Put the new jar in your mods folder and restart the game.
hotwire.off_code.world: It's off, but your world still holds things it made while it was on. Reopen the world and they're gone.
hotwire.off_code.ran: %s is off, but some of its code just ran. Hotwire couldn't take all of it out. %s
hotwire.off_code.restart: Turning it back on makes it whole again; a restart clears it.
hotwire.off_code.used_by: %1$s is off, but %2$s still runs its code. Turning %2$s off too clears it, and from now on it goes off with %1$s.
hotwire.off_code.reopen: Save and reopen your world to clear what it holds. A restart clears all of it.
hotwire.crash.title: Hotwire caught a crash
hotwire.crash.off_held: %s is off, but a piece of it the game still had crashed. Hotwire kept the game going. A restart clears it. %s
hotwire.crash.turned_off: %s crashed, so Hotwire turned it off. The game goes on. %s
hotwire.crash.not_turned_off: %s crashed and couldn't be turned off: %s %s
hotwire.own_fault.title: Hotwire caught a fault of its own
hotwire.own_fault: Hotwire's own code failed inside the game, which went on past it: %s. Restarting the game is the safe way on. %s
hotwire.report.title: Your bug report is ready
hotwire.report.failure_title: That didn't work, so Hotwire wrote a bug report
hotwire.report.send: Send that one file where you got Hotwire. Nothing is sent on its own.
hotwire.report.holds: It holds the game log and what Hotwire did, with your name and login taken out.
hotwire.report.failed: The bug report couldn't be written: %s
hotwire.update.also: Also updates %s to %s, which it carries.
hotwire.picker.title: Add a mod
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.hotwire: Turn mods off and on, add and update them, all while the game runs.
hotwire.switch.hint.session: Only until you close the game. Change that under Advanced.
hotwire.chooser.store_note: Discover mods and install them here.
hotwire.chooser.hotwire_note: Turn your mods off and on.
hotwire.store.no_version: %s has no version for your Minecraft and Fabric.
hotwire.store.pack.downloaded: %s is downloaded. Turn it on with its switch.
hotwire.store.pack.shader_needs_iris: Shaders need Iris. Get it in the Mods tab first.
